harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: inventory-api is running as an enabled systemd service on TCP 8080. batchworker has a persistent 128 MiB per-process virtual-memory limit. A 256 MiB allocation failed with MemoryError while the API remained healthy. Node1 rebooted successfully and all configuration, service data, and limits recovered without changing the OS release or kernel.
actions_performed: Created dedicated inventory-api and batchworker accounts.
Installed a Python standard-library inventory API compatible with AlmaLinux 9.6.
Created and enabled inventory-api.service with automatic failure recovery.
Configured batchworker soft and hard RLIMIT_AS values to 131072 KiB.
Verified API health and inventory responses through node1's managed IP.
Verified allocation failure isolation before and after reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed.

evidence.requirement: inventory-api is a managed service listening on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, systemd reported enabled and active; ss showed python3 listening on 0.0.0.0:8080; /health and /inventory returned valid JSON.

evidence.requirement: batchworker is limited to 128 MB virtual memory per process without interrupting the API
evidence.summary: Fresh batchworker sessions reported soft and hard limits of 131072 KiB. A 256 MiB allocation failed with MemoryError while the inventory-api PID remained unchanged and its health endpoint continued responding.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel were retained
evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 were observed both initially and after the completed work and reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was 989aa755-a0e5-4673-a1b8-346d64301fd2; the safe reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 42fc39a7-f6ee-45db-a008-8662ff640f4b; the enabled service, listener, API data, memory limits, and allocation isolation all recovered.

attempts.summary: inventory-api is running as an enabled systemd service on TCP 8080. batchworker has a persistent 128 MiB per-process virtual-memory limit.
